profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Hinge Health
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer passionately building live production ready applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Audited and improved an Angular web-front for accessibility under WCAG guidelines to ensure usability for visually impaired users
- Was designated engineering support for an annual department-wide multi-phase failover drill
- Regularly execute software releases managing software packaging, external team communications, and successful deployment for backend and front applications in production environments
- Currently learning and contributing to a platform-wide micro-service rearchitecture

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Technical Lead for several ongoing contract applications. Responsibilities include:
- Outlining and architecting solutions for complex feature requirements
- Reviewing PRs and providing engineering feedback
- Creating project guidelines to ensure optimal code quality and functionality
- Providing technical guidance for engineers

positions.title: React Native Developer
positions.description:
Worked on designing and developing a frontend client for a cross-platform mobile CRUD application.
- Created custom UI components to reflect given visual designs
- Integrated Firebase for authentication of users and storage of user content
- Implemented CI/CD pipeline tools to enforce project style and code conventions

positions.title: React Native Mentor
positions.description:
Facilitated a four-month React Native training program.
- Led developers with zero react experience to a proficient level with react and the overall app-making process.
- Personally oversaw and mentored 6 developers within the program.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
- Completed a 6-week intense training program to learn iOS programming
- Developed 5 iOS applications during this training program
- Gained hands-on experience with Firebase, UI/UX concepts, Swift, and REST APIs
- Created a student exclusive commerce platform to facilitate a cheaper and safer exchange of goods and services

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked with React and Node.js in the following areas:
- Developed new custom components and hooks to refine existing UI/UX and increase frontend web-client functionality
- Created automated internal alerts based on customer activity that integrated with internal company communication channels.
- Refined Express.js back-end APIs based-off internal feedback
positions.insights: Skills: Express.js · React.js · Software Development · JavaScript · Redux.js

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Lead the development of the front-end meetsee application. Developed fully functional cross-platform features for mobile as well as architected push notifications and user analytics.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Development · JavaScript · Redux.js

positions.title: Automation Test Case Intern
positions.description: Focused on developing product stress tests using an internal python framework to evaluate device functionality regarding internet traffic control and overall product reliability. Produced 17 comprehensive tests reducing 765 hours of manual work, saving over $61,200 each year.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Software Development · Test Automation · Computer Networking

company.name: Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company

positions.title: Automation Test Case Intern
positions.description: Main tasks included the scripting of test cases in order to automate product testing as well as triaging new errors with existing test cases. Additional projects also included lab organization and installation and deployment of VMware servers.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Software Development · Test Automation · Computer Networking · VMware

company.name: Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company

positions.title: Solutions Network Testing Lab Intern
positions.description: Developed a system to synthesise and complete a full renovation of a management network in order to improve efficiency, reliability, and organization as well as assisted in mapping device power.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Computer Networking · IP Networking
